name: TAO
description: A large-vocabulary tracking dataset with about 2,907 videos and 833 categories. This record is metadata-only and vendors no data.
citation: Dave, A., Khurana, T., Tokmakov, P., Schmid, C., & Ramanan, D. (2020). TAO: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Tracking Any Object. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
